verdict.rationale: Whether an AI assistant product publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. No first-party evidence shows Claude or Claude Code's source is available under an open license. Community comments contrast Claude Code with FOSS Codex CLI, and one user reports Claude wrongly claiming Claude Code was open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
